tax_invoices_json_shape_check.value:
case when jsonb_typeof("tax_invoices"."lines") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("tax_invoices"."lines") between 1 and 8 else false end
        and jsonb_typeof("tax_invoices"."supplier") = 'object' and jsonb_typeof("tax_invoices"."recipient") = 'object'

tax_invoices_number_check.name: tax_invoices_number_check
tax_invoices_number_check.value:
"tax_invoices"."serial" between 1 and 999999 and "tax_invoices"."financial_year" ~ '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' and "tax_invoices"."prefix" ~ '^[A-Z0-9]+$'
        and length("tax_invoices"."number") <= 16
        and "tax_invoices"."number" = "tax_invoices"."prefix" || '/' || "tax_invoices"."financial_year" || '/' || lpad("tax_invoices"."serial"::text, 6, '0')

tax_invoices_financial_year_check.name: tax_invoices_financial_year_check
tax_invoices_financial_year_check.value:
"tax_invoices"."financial_year" = lpad((((extract(year from "tax_invoices"."issued_on") - (case when extract(month from "tax_invoices"."issued_on") < 4 then 1 else 0 end)) % 100)::int)::text, 2, '0')
        || '-' || lpad((((extract(year from "tax_invoices"."issued_on") - (case when extract(month from "tax_invoices"."issued_on") < 4 then 1 else 0 end) + 1) % 100)::int)::text, 2, '0')

tax_invoices_place_of_supply_check.name: tax_invoices_place_of_supply_check
tax_invoices_place_of_supply_check.value:
"tax_invoices"."place_of_supply_state_code" ~ '^[a-z]{2}$'
        and coalesce("tax_invoices"."supplier"->>'stateCode' ~ '^[a-z]{2}$', false)
        and ("tax_invoices"."supply_type" = 'intra_state') = ("tax_invoices"."place_of_supply_state_code" = "tax_invoices"."supplier"->>'stateCode')
        and ("tax_invoices"."place_of_supply_basis" <> 'gstin' or "tax_invoices"."recipient"->>'gstin' is not null)
        and ("tax_invoices"."place_of_supply_basis" <> 'supplier_location' or "tax_invoices"."place_of_supply_state_code" = "tax_invoices"."supplier"->>'stateCode')
        and ("tax_invoices"."recipient"->>'gstin' is null or "tax_invoices"."recipient"->>'gstin' ~ '^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$')

tax_invoices_recipient_check.name: tax_invoices_recipient_check
tax_invoices_recipient_check.value:
("tax_invoices"."recipient"->>'stateCode' is null or "tax_invoices"."recipient"->>'stateCode' ~ '^[a-z]{2}$')
        and "tax_invoices"."recipient"->>'email' is null and "tax_invoices"."recipient"->>'phone' is null
        and ("tax_invoices"."place_of_supply_basis" <> 'billing_address'
          or (coalesce("tax_invoices"."place_of_supply_state_code" = "tax_invoices"."recipient"->>'stateCode', false) and "tax_invoices"."recipient"->>'gstin' is null))
        and ("tax_invoices"."place_of_supply_basis" <> 'supplier_location'
          or ("tax_invoices"."recipient"->>'gstin' is null and "tax_invoices"."recipient"->>'stateCode' is null))

tax_invoices_total_check.name: tax_invoices_total_check
tax_invoices_total_check.value:
"tax_invoices"."taxable_cents" > 0 and "tax_invoices"."cgst_cents" >= 0 and "tax_invoices"."igst_cents" >= 0 and "tax_invoices"."total_cents" > 0
        and "tax_invoices"."total_cents" = "tax_invoices"."taxable_cents" + "tax_invoices"."cgst_cents" + "tax_invoices"."sgst_cents" + "tax_invoices"."igst_cents" + "tax_invoices"."round_off_cents"
        and case when jsonb_typeof("tax_invoices"."lines") = 'array' then abs("tax_invoices"."round_off_cents") <= jsonb_array_length("tax_invoices"."lines") else false end

support_attachments_association_check.name: support_attachments_association_check
support_attachments_association_check.value: ("support_attachments"."ticket_id" is null) = ("support_attachments"."message_id" is null) and ("support_attachments"."state" <> 'attached' or "support_attachments"."message_id" is not null) and ("support_attachments"."state" <> 'staged' or "support_attachments"."message_id" is null)

support_attachments_image_check.name: support_attachments_image_check
support_attachments_image_check.value: "support_attachments"."mime_type" in ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp') and "support_attachments"."width" is not null and "support_attachments"."height" is not null and "support_attachments"."width" between 1 and 12000 and "support_attachments"."height" between 1 and 12000 and "support_attachments"."width"::bigint * "support_attachments"."height"::bigint <= 16000000
